intro: The Etched Rune is a written summons delivered to novice dwarven hunters assisting the guard in Coldridge Valley. Passed on by Sten Stoutarm, the inscribed stone directs fledgling trackers to seek out Thorgas Grimson inside Anvilmar to formally begin their martial and wilderness training.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the adventurer trainer Thorgas. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ya made it! Good to hear! Betcha didn't have to track me to find the place either. Haha!

Our profession is pretty steeped in tradition, friend. Learning the ways of the land. Learning to track a bear through the mountains. Even just surviving on wits alone takes a great deal of courage and cunning. Think you're capable?

clips.title: Completion
paras: One thing you should always remember is that you gotta respect the world you're livin' in. The beasts that choose to fight along side you; the shine of your weapon; the weight of your ammo; the bite of a bitter wind; all these things you need to know intimately.
I'll do what I can to help you, but most of the work's up to you. Anytime you think you're ready, come back and talk to me. I'll train you when I can.
